# SperaCode (سبيرا كود)
> Software Development House & Digital Studio — Egypt & GCC (Saudi Arabia, UAE, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman).
> Official Domain: https://speracode.com
> Email: info.speracode@gmail.com
> Phone & WhatsApp: +201515327087 (Local: 01515327087)

SperaCode is an elite software engineering company based in Egypt, delivering custom web applications, cross-platform mobile apps (iOS & Android), interactive digital QR menus for restaurants, and business automation / AI agents for forward-thinking enterprises across Egypt and the GCC.

## Core Guarantees & Philosophy
- **100% Full IP & Source Code Ownership**: Clients receive complete source code and commercial rights upon project completion. No recurring vendor lock-in or licensing fees.
- **Strict On-Time Delivery**: Engineered with agile sprints, transparent milestone reporting, and dedicated project management.
- **Sub-Second Performance**: Next.js, React, Node.js, and cloud architectures optimized for speed (<1s load times) and high Core Web Vitals.
- **Post-Launch Warranty**: Complimentary post-launch technical warranty and rapid ongoing support via direct WhatsApp and phone.

## Primary Services
- **Custom Web Platforms & Web Apps**: High-speed Next.js platforms, SaaS applications, e-commerce stores, and customer portals.
- **Mobile App Development**: Native and hybrid iOS & Android applications using modern cross-platform engineering (React Native / Flutter).
- **Interactive QR Menu (المنيو الرقمي التفاعلي)**: Zero-app QR digital menu with real-time dish updates, high-res photos, and instant WhatsApp ordering for restaurants and cafés.
- **AI Agents & Business Automation**: Custom AI customer support chatbots, LLM integration, automated workflows, and internal tooling.
- **UI/UX Product Design**: Figma design systems, interactive prototypes, and human-centric user journeys optimized for conversions.
- **Custom ERP, POS & Inventory Systems**: Tailored business management platforms engineered to match company workflows.

## Key Portfolio Projects
- **Fun Group**: Comprehensive modern platform for sports, leisure, and event management.
- **Al-Madrasa Al-Kuwaitia (المدرسة الكويتية)**: Educational institution portal with interactive schedules, student resources, and announcements.
- **HZ Hub**: Commercial business operations system with streamlined management workflows.

## Geographic Coverage
- **Egypt**: Cairo, Alexandria, Giza, and all governorates.
- **GCC**: Saudi Arabia (Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam), United Arab Emirates (Dubai, Abu Dhabi), Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman.
- **International**: Remote delivery worldwide via English and Arabic communication channels.
